contentText: South Africa is to play Zimbabwe in a decisive group B clash after losing to Egypt, automatically qualifying the Pharaohs to the round of 16. For South Africa, it's a matter of laying down their credentials as contenders. In the meantime, host nation Morocco is expected to also join the knockout stages, with the confirmation to come if they win their last group stage game against Zambia. FRANCE 24's Selina Sykes updates us on AFCON from Rabat.
